title: why i'm spending $2.6m on my health...
description:
Watch  @BryanJohnson's  breakdown of the full protocol:
https://youtu.be/iuRr_5j9qkY

For years, I helped Bryan Johnson build one of the most comprehensive longevity protocols in the world.

Now, I’m about to become the experiment.

Over the next 100 days, Bryan and I are spending $2.6 million to make me one of the most measured women in history – tracking 1,900 biomarkers, 16 biological systems and more than 14 million data points across three menstrual cycles.

But this film is less about the numbers, and more about what it feels like to hand over your body to an experiment this intense. Why I decided to do it. What I’m afraid of. And what I hope we might learn for women everywhere.

This is an N of 1. We aren’t going to have all the answers. But we can start asking better questions.

I’ll be sharing the entire experiment – the data, discoveries, mistakes and everything in between.

Subscribe and come figure this out with me  :)

Follow me:
Instagram: https://instagram.com/katetolo
TikTok: https://tiktok.com/@katetolo
X: https://x.com/katetolo

This video documents my personal experience and is for informational purposes only. It is not medical advice.
